model_name: Granite Vision 4.1 4B（軸レンジなし、合成図で学習、ローカル）
metric: normalized-y-distance, span floor 5% of linear y axis (design 7.66)
point_metric: point-level recall/precision/F1 of marker positions, axis-range-normalized (log axes in log10), one-to-one Hungarian per series pair (count of pairs within tau maximized), series assigned by 1 - F1_tau; primary: macro point_f1 at tau 0.02 (design 7.67)

point_metrics.dense_criterion: dense when the median, over the ground-truth points, of the distance to the nearest point of the same series in the axis-normalized space (log axes in log10) is below 2*tau, tau = the primary point tau (0.02 -> 0.04); dense figures leave point_metrics and are summarized on curve distance in dense_marker_metrics (design 7.72)

dense_marker_metrics.criterion: dense when the median, over the ground-truth points, of the distance to the nearest point of the same series in the axis-normalized space (log axes in log10) is below 2*tau, tau = the primary point tau (0.02 -> 0.04); dense figures leave point_metrics and are summarized on curve distance in dense_marker_metrics (design 7.72)

condition: 軸レンジなし。画像だけを入力し、モデル自身の表抽出をそのまま使う。LLM に渡した軸ごとの報告規則(log10 目盛は 10^値、°C 印字は K)は、採点時に同じ規則を決定論的に適用した(design 7.75)。
